doc.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: Closing remarks and a gig at age 80
summary: Final thanks and a contract for a gig in 2000.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been absolutely fascinating. I really appreciate it.
I hope I’ve covered enough, if I think of anything else I’ll yell.
All right. And best of luck to you. I have a feeling that the gigs won’t run out on you.
As a matter of fact, if I can make it I’ve got a gig, I won’t say anything about bad luck or good luck, but in 2000 I have a gig, I’ll be 80 years old, and I’d better make it.
I signed the contract. That’s set. I’ve got to be there. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
All right. Well thanks so much. I appreciate it.
Thank you, Monk. © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-
